Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 5 (test build)

Test build with your name always shared with connections, your full email in the account view, history search and item limits.

Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • Your shared profile always carries your first and last name, and you can change your name from the app (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.18.0).
  • The account view shows your full email, and your history can be searched inside the vault (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.20.0).
  • Kept values, item size limits, dry runs, named limits and fixes to sharing (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.21.0).
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 26b7140 (tag release/staging/5) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-08 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
